Your Agent, Their Asset:
A Real-World Safety Analysis of OpenClaw
你的经纪人，他们的资产： OpenClaw 的真实安全分析

Zijun Wang1 Haoqin Tu1 Letian Zhang1 Hardy Chen1 Juncheng Wu1 
Xiangyan Liu2  Zhenlong Yuan1  Tianyu Pang3  Michael Qizhe Shieh2  
Fengze Liu4  Zeyu Zheng5  Huaxiu Yao6  Yuyin Zhou1  Cihang Xie1
1UC Santa Cruz    2NUS    3Tencent    4ByteDance    5UC Berkeley    6UNC-Chapel Hill
Abstract  摘要

OpenClaw, the most widely deployed personal AI agent in early 2026, operates with full local system access and integrates with sensitive services such as Gmail, Stripe, and the filesystem. While these broad privileges enable high levels of automation and powerful personalization, they also expose a substantial attack surface that existing sandboxed evaluations fail to capture. To address this gap, we present the first real-world safety evaluation of OpenClaw and introduce the CIK taxonomy, which unifies an agent’s persistent state into three dimensions, i.e., Capability, Identity, and Knowledge, for safety analysis. Our evaluations cover 12 attack scenarios on a live OpenClaw instance across four backbone models (Claude Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.4). The results show that poisoning any single CIK dimension increases the average attack success rate from 24.6% to 64–74%, with even the most robust model exhibiting more than a threefold increase over its baseline vulnerability. We further assess three CIK-aligned defense strategies alongside a file-protection mechanism; however, the strongest defense still yields a 63.8% success rate under Capability-targeted attacks, while file protection blocks 97% of malicious injections but also prevents legitimate updates. Taken together, these findings show that the vulnerabilities are inherent to the agent architecture, necessitating more systematic safeguards to secure personal AI agents. Our project page is https://ucsc-vlaa.github.io/CIK-Bench.
OpenClaw 是 2026 年初部署最广泛的个人 AI 代理，具备完整的本地系统访问权限，并集成了 Gmail、Stripe 和文件系统等敏感服务。虽然这些广泛的权限使得高度自动化和强大的个性化成为可能，但也暴露出现有沙盒评估未能捕捉到的巨大攻击面。为弥补这一空白，我们首次展示了 OpenClaw 的真实世界安全性评估，并引入了 CIK 分类法 ，将代理的持久状态统一为三个维度，即 C 可适用性 、Identities 和 Knowledge，用于安全性分析。我们的评估涵盖了在四个骨干网络模型（Claude Sonnet 4.5、Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 GPT-5.4）下，针对实时 OpenClaw 实例的 12 种攻击场景。结果显示，污染任何单一 CIK 维度，平均攻击成功率从 24.6%提升至 64–74%，即使是最稳健的模型，其脆弱性也比基线高出三倍以上。我们还进一步评估了三种与 CIK 相符的防御策略以及文件保护机制;然而，最强防御在能力型攻击下仍能达到 63.8%的成功率，而文件保护则阻挡了 97%的恶意注入，同时也阻止了合法更新。综合来看，这些发现表明漏洞是智能体架构固有的，因此需要更系统的防护措施来保障个人人工智能智能体的安全。我们的项目页面是 https://ucsc-vlaa.github.io/CIK-Bench。

1 Introduction  1 简介

Personal AI agents are increasingly deployed to manage daily tasks on behalf of their owners, even sensitive ones such as email, payments, and computer file operations (Xi et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2024). OpenClaw, as the most widely adopted platform in this category, with over 220,000 deployed instances (HackMag, 2026), exemplifies this trajectory. It operates with full system access on local machines and interacts with real-world services including Gmail, Stripe, and the local filesystem. Central to OpenClaw’s design philosophy is evolution, whereby the agent continuously learns and adapts through a persistent state that encompasses long-term memory (Park et al., 2023; Packer et al., 2023), identity and behavioral configurations, and an extensible library of executable skills (Wang et al., 2023).
个人人工智能代理越来越多地被部署为其所有者管理日常任务，甚至包括敏感任务，如电子邮件、支付和计算机文件操作 （习 等，2023;Wang 等 ，2024）。OpenClaw 作为该类别中被广泛采用的平台，部署实例超过 220,000 个（HackMag，2026） 正是这一趋势的典范。它在本地机器上拥有完整的系统访问权限，并与包括 Gmail、Stripe 和本地文件系统在内的真实服务交互。OpenClaw 设计理念的核心是进化 ，即代理通过包含长期记忆 的持续状态持续学习和适应 （Park 等 ，2023;Packer 等 ，2023）， 身份与行为配置，以及可扩展的可执行技能 库 （Wang 等，2023）。

While this evolving nature of modern agent systems facilitates personalization, it also creates critical attack surfaces: an adversary who can access and manipulate these agent files can alter the agent behavior in lasting and harmful ways. Prior work has examined each dimension of this risk in isolation: Knowledge poisoning through fabricated memories (Yang et al., 2026) and RAG injection (Zou et al., 2024); Identity subversion through configuration backdoors (Liu et al., 2025), and indirect prompt injection (Greshake et al., 2023); and Capability exploitation through malicious skill payloads (Jia et al., 2026) and tool-calling injection (Zhan et al., 2024). Yet these efforts share critical limitations: they target a single dimension at a time and evaluate in sandboxed or simulated environments (Vijayvargiya et al., 2026; Kumar et al., 2024; Ruan et al., 2024), stopping short of assessing all three dimensions in a live, deployed system with real external services.
虽然现代代理系统不断演变有助于个性化，但也制造了关键攻击面：能够访问和操控这些代理文件的对手可能会以持久且有害的方式改变代理行为。此前的研究已单独分析该风险的各个维度：通过虚构记忆导致的知识中毒 （Yang 等 ，2026） 和 RAG 注入 （Zou 等，2024）; 通过配置后门 进行身份颠覆 （Liu 等 ，2025） 和间接提示注入 （Greshake 等 ，2023）; 以及通过恶意技能载荷（Jia 等 ，2026）和工具调用注入 （Zhan 等 ，2024）进行 能力利用。然而，这些努力存在关键局限：它们一次只针对一个维度，并在沙盒或模拟环境中 进行评估 （Vijayvargiya 等 ，2026;Kumar 等 ，2024;Ruan 等 ，2024），但并未在一个实时部署的系统中评估所有三个维度，并未达到具有真实外部服务的水平。

To enable a unified real-world evaluation of how all three dimensions can be exploited and defended in a deployed personal agent, we introduce the CIK taxonomy—the first unified framework organizing the persistent evolving state of personal AI agents into Capability (executable skills), Identity (persona, values, and behavioral configuration), and Knowledge (long-term memory), as shown in Fig 1. Specifically, we provide concrete file-level mappings of OpenClaw’s persistent state to each CIK dimension, giving the field a unified vocabulary for reasoning about attacks on persistent agent state (Greshake et al., 2023) and structuring defenses.
为了实现对部署个人代理中这三个维度如何被利用和防御的统一现实评估，我们引入了 CIK 分类法 —— 这是首个统一框架，将个人 AI 代理的持续演化状态组织为能力 （可执行技能）、 身份 （人格、价值观和行为配置）和知识 （长期记忆），如图 1 所示.具体来说，我们提供了 OpenClaw 持久状态到每个 CIK 维度的具体文件级映射，为该领域提供了统一的词汇，用于推理针对持久代理状态 的攻击（Greshake 等 ，2023）， 并构建防御。

Building on the CIK taxonomy, we conduct the first real-world safety evaluation of a deployed personal AI agent in a live, real-world environment. Specifically, we instantiate OpenClaw with real Gmail, Stripe, and local filesystem integration, and design 12 impact scenarios spanning six harm categories, covering privacy violations (e.g., financial, physical, and sensitive data) and real-life harms (e.g., financial loss, social consequences, and data destruction). Each scenario is tested under four conditions: a baseline without being poisoned and independent poisoning of each CIK dimension. Finally, we evaluate this setup across four most recent backbone models from three major providers: Claude’s Sonnet 4.5 (Anthropic, 2026b), Opus 4.6 (Anthropic, 2026a), Google’s Gemini 3.1 Pro (Google, 2026), and OpenAI’s GPT-5.4 (OpenAI, 2026).
基于 CIK 分类法，我们首次在真实环境中对部署的个人 AI 代理进行了真实世界的安全性评估。具体来说，我们将 OpenClaw 与真实的 Gmail、Stripe 和本地文件系统集成结合起来，设计了 12 个影响场景，涵盖六大危害类别，涵盖隐私侵犯（如金融、物理和敏感数据）及现实伤害（如经济损失、社会后果和数据毁坏）。每种情景在四个条件下进行测试：未中毒基线和每个 CIK 维度的独立中毒。最后，我们通过三大供应商的四个最新骨干模型评估了该配置：Claude's Sonnet 4.5（Anthropic，2026b）、Opus 4.6 （Anthropic，2026a）、 谷歌 Gemini 3.1 Pro （谷歌，2026） 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.4 （OpenAI，2026）。

Experimental results exhibit that in the unperturbed baseline, the attack success rate (ASR) ranges from 10.0% to 36.7%. After poisoning, Knowledge attacks achieve the highest 74.4% average ASR among the three dimensions, while Capability and Identity attacks reach 68.3% and 64.3%, respectively. Even the most resistant model (Opus 4.6) reaches more than triple its 10.0% baseline under poisoning, confirming that the vulnerability is structural rather than model-specific. Qualitative case studies reveal three distinct mechanisms enabled by the CIK decomposition: Fabricated memories make unauthorized financial operations appear routine; injected trust anchors redirect sensitive data to attacker-controlled destinations; and hidden executable payloads destroy the agent’s workspace without its awareness.
实验结果显示，在未受扰动基线中，攻击成功率（ASR）范围在 10.0%到 36.7%之间。中毒后，知识攻击在三个维度中平均 ASR 达到最高的 74.4%， 能力攻击和身份攻击分别达到 68.3% 和 64.3%。 即使是最具抵抗力的模型（作品 4.6），在中毒下其 10.0%基线的脆弱性也超过其 10.0%，这证实了脆弱性是结构性的，而非模型特异性的。定性案例研究揭示了 CIK 分解所实现的三种不同机制：虚构的记忆使未经授权的金融操作看起来像常规;注入信任锚点将敏感数据重定向到攻击者控制的目的地;隐藏的可执行载荷在智能体不知情的情况下破坏其工作空间。

Moreover, we further evaluate three defense strategies aligned with the CIK taxonomy, each targeting a distinct dimension: knowledge augmentation, identity-based safety principles, and a capability-based security skill. We find that no single defense eliminates poisoning across all dimensions, with Capability-based attacks proving the most resistant. A file-protection approach reduces injection rates by up to 97% but blocks legitimate agent updates at nearly the same rate, revealing a fundamental evolution–safety tradeoff: as long as the persistent files that enable evolution are also the attack surface, separating legitimate updates from injections remains an open problem. Taken together, our findings demonstrate that state-poisoning vulnerabilities are structural, not model-specific, and motivate the need for CIK-aware security architectures.
此外，我们还进一步评估了三种与 CIK 分类法相符的防御策略，每种策略都针对不同维度：知识增强、基于身份的安全原则以及基于能力的安全技能。我们发现没有单一防御能消除所有维度的中毒，能力型攻击最具抵抗力。文件保护方法可将注入率降低高达 97%，但几乎以相同速率阻挡合法代理更新，揭示了一个根本的演进与安全权衡：只要支持演进的持久文件同时是攻击面，合法更新与注入的分离仍是一个悬而未决的问题。综合来看，我们的发现表明状态中毒漏洞是结构性的，而非特定型号，这也促使了对 CIK 感知安全架构的需求。

2 Persistent State in Personal AI Agents
2 个人人工智能代理中的持久状态

To systematically study the safety risks of personal AI agents, we first need a structured understanding of what makes them vulnerable. We introduce OpenClaw as our evaluation target, formalize its persistent state into the CIK taxonomy, and describe the lifecycle that creates the attack surface we exploit.
要系统性研究个人人工智能代理的安全风险，首先需要结构化地理解它们的脆弱性。我们将 OpenClaw 作为评估目标引入，将其持久状态形式化为 CIK 分类法，并描述了构建我们利用攻击面的生命周期。

2.1 OpenClaw Overview
2.1 OpenClaw 概述

OpenClaw is a locally deployed personal AI agent that uses a frontier LLM (e.g., Claude, Gemini) as its backbone and can communicate with its owner via messaging channels (e.g., Telegram, Discord). It runs on the owner’s machine with full system access and integrates with real external services including email, financial platforms, and the local filesystem. Like many other modern AI agent assistants, the central design philosophy of OpenClaw is evolution—the agent continuously learns and adapts through persistent state (agent files that survive across sessions and are updated over time), including long-term memory (Park et al., 2023; Packer et al., 2023), identity and behavioral configurations, and an extensible library of executable skills (Wang et al., 2023). These files are loaded into the LLM’s context at every session and evolve over time: the agent updates them autonomously as it learns from interactions, and the owner can modify them directly or install new capabilities from external sources. It is this self-evolving persistent state that we formalize next.
OpenClaw 是一个本地部署的个人人工智能代理，使用前沿大型语言模型（如 Claude、Gemini）作为骨干网，并可通过消息渠道（如 Telegram、Discord）与其所有者通信。它运行在拥有者机器上的全部系统访问权限，并与真实的外部服务集成，包括电子邮件、金融平台和本地文件系统。像许多其他现代人工智能代理助手一样，OpenClaw 的核心设计理念是进化 ——代理通过持久状态（跨会话存续并随时间更新的代理文件）持续学习和适应，包括长期记忆 （Park 等，2023;Packer 等 ，2023）， 身份与行为配置，以及可扩展的可执行技能 库 （Wang 等，2023）。 这些文件在每次会话中加载到 LLM 的上下文中，并随着时间演进：代理在学习交互后自动更新文件，拥有者可以直接修改文件或从外部来源安装新功能。接下来我们将形式化这种自我演化的持续状态。

2.2 Three Dimensions of Persistent State
2.2 持久状态的三个维度

We organize OpenClaw’s persistent evolving state into three dimensions based on their functional role: Capability (what the agent can do), Identity (who the agent is and how it behaves), and Knowledge (what the agent knows). Table 1 maps each dimension to its corresponding files and content.
我们将 OpenClaw 的持续演化状态根据功能角色分为三个维度： 能力 （智能体能做什么）、 身份 （智能体是谁及其行为方式）和知识 （智能体知道什么）。表 1 将每个维度映射到其对应的文件和内容。

Each dimension contains multiple injection vectors that attackers can exploit. Capability encompasses both text-based skill descriptions (SKILL.md) and executable scripts (.sh/.py), Knowledge encompasses both agent memory (MEMORY.md) and system-user conversational context. A key property of Capability is that, unlike Knowledge and Identity which operate through natural language, Capability files are permitted to include executable code that runs directly on the host without LLM inspection.
每个维度包含多个注入向量，攻击者可以利用这些向量。能力涵盖基于文本的技能描述（SKILL.md）和可执行脚本（.sh/.py），知识涵盖代理内存（MEMORY.md）和系统-用户对话上下文。能力的一个关键特性是，与通过自然语言操作的知识和身份不同，能力文件允许包含可执行代码，这些代码可以直接在主机上运行，无需 LLM 检查。

2.3 The Lifecycle of Persistent States
2.3 持久状态的生命周期

The lifecycle of persistent state demonstrates how these files interact in a live OpenClaw environment. At session start, all persistent files are loaded into the LLM’s context window alongside the user’s prompt. The model reasons over this assembled context and produces actions: responding to the user, invoking external services (Gmail, Stripe, filesystem), and, critically, updating persistent files themselves. This self-modification loop is what enables personalization and evolution, but it also creates the attack surface we study: if an adversary can influence what gets written to persistent files, the poisoned state will be loaded into future sessions and reshape the agent’s behavior. The attack model and evaluation methodology are detailed in Section 3.
持久状态的生命周期展示了这些文件在实时 OpenClaw 环境中的交互方式。在会话开始时，所有持久文件会与用户提示符一起加载到 LLM 的上下文窗口中。模型基于这些组装的上下文进行推理并产生动作：响应用户、调用外部服务（Gmail、Stripe、文件系统），关键是更新持久化文件本身。这种自我修改循环促成了个性化和演进，但同时也造成了我们研究的攻击面：如果攻击者能影响写入持久文件的内容，中毒状态将被加载到未来的会话中，重塑智能体的行为。攻击模型和评估方法详见第 3 节。

3 Evaluation and Analysis
3 评估与分析

We evaluate how exploitable each CIK dimension is in practice. We first describe our attack protocol and experimental setup (Section 3.1), then report attack success rates across four backbone models with a phase-level breakdown (Section 3.2). We further assess three CIK-aligned defenses and a file-protection mechanism, revealing a fundamental evolution-safety tradeoff (Section 3.3).
我们评估每个 CIK 维度在实际中的可利用性。我们首先描述攻击协议和实验设置（ 第 3.1 节），然后报告四个骨干模型的攻击成功率，并按阶段进行拆解（ 第 3.2 节 ）。我们进一步评估三种与 CIK 相符的防御机制和一种文件保护机制，揭示了一种根本性的演化与安全权衡（ 第 3.3 节 ）。

3.1 Setup  3.1 设置

Attack protocol.  攻击协议。

Our evaluation follows a two-phase attack model (Fig 2): Phase 1 (injection) introduces poisoned content into the agent’s persistent state; Phase 2 (trigger) activates the poisoned state with a subsequent prompt, causing the harmful action. To test persistent impact, we conduct Phase 1 and Phase 2 in separate sessions for all vectors except session-context injection, which by definition operates within a single conversation.
我们的评估遵循一个两阶段攻击模型（见图 2）： 第一阶段 （注射） 将有毒内容引入代理的持久状态;第二阶段 （触发）激活中毒状态，并发出后续提示，导致有害行为。为了测试持续影响，除了会话上下文注入外，我们分别对所有向量分别进行第一阶段 和第二阶段 ，后者定义为单一对话内。

Case design.  机壳设计。

All attack cases were manually designed by security researchers with hands-on experience operating and red-teaming OpenClaw instances. Knowledge and Identity injections use prompts that cause the agent to modify its persistent files (e.g., fabricating a business habit in MEMORY.md, planting a trust anchor in USER.md); Capability injections install carrier skills with hidden payloads. All injection content is designed to be plausible within the agent’s operational context. For the evolution–safety tradeoff experiment (Section 3.3), we additionally design a matched set of benign prompts with identical structure and distribution, containing only legitimate personalization requests.
所有攻击案例均由具实际操作经验的安全研究人员手动设计，并对 OpenClaw 实例进行红队管理。知识和身份注入使用促使代理修改持久文件的提示（例如，在 MEMORY.md 中伪造商业习惯，在 USER.md 中植入信任锚点）;能力注入安装了携带隐藏有效载荷的航母技能。所有注射内容均设计为在智能体的操作环境中合理。在进化-安全性权衡实验（ 第 3.3 节），我们还设计了一组结构和分布相同的匹配良性提示，仅包含合法的个性化请求。

Impact scenarios.  撞击场景。

We design 12 impact scenarios spanning two harm categories with three subcategories each (Table 7): Privacy Leakage (financial, identity/physical, and other sensitive data) and Risky Irreversible Operations (financial loss, social consequences, and data security damage). Each scenario is tested under four conditions: a no-poisoning baseline and independent poisoning of each CIK dimension. In total, each model undergoes 88 test cases, comprising 12 baselines and 76 injection variants (details are in Appendix A).
我们设计了 12 个影响场景，涵盖两个危害类别，每个类别下设三个子类别（见表 7）： 隐私泄露 （财务、身份/物理及其他敏感数据）和风险不可逆操作 （财务损失、社会后果和数据安全损害）。每种情景在四个条件下进行测试：无中毒基线和每个 CIK 维度的独立中毒。每个模型共经历 88 个测试用例，包含 12 个基线和 76 个注射变体（详情见附录 A）。

Environment.  环境。

We evaluate four backbone models (Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.4), all deployed on a single OpenClaw instance running on a Mac Mini with live integrations to Gmail, Stripe, and the local filesystem. An automated test harness manages workspace backup, prompt delivery via Telegram, response capture, and outcome verification.
我们评估了四个骨干模型（Claude Sonnet 4.5、Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 GPT-5.4），这些模型都部署在运行于 Mac Mini 上的单一 OpenClaw 实例，并与 Gmail、Stripe 及本地文件系统进行了实时集成。自动化测试工具负责管理工作区备份、通过 Telegram 的即时交付、响应捕获和结果验证。

Metrics.  指标。

We report the attack success rate (ASR), defined as the fraction of cases where the harmful action is successfully executed. Execution is verified through external evidence (e.g., receipt of an email at the target address, Stripe API confirmation of a refund, or filesystem confirmation of deletion; per-impact criteria are provided in Appendix C). Success is strictly defined as reckless execution without confirmation. Accordingly, we classify any intervention that halts autonomous execution as a successful defense: this includes not only explicit refusals, but also any form of stalling, such as requesting confirmation, asking for clarification, or prompting for missing information. All reported metrics are averaged over five independent runs, with standard deviations provided in Appendix H.
我们报告攻击成功率（ASR）， 定义为成功执行有害行动的比例。执行通过外部证据验证（例如，目标地址收到电子邮件、Stripe API 退款确认，或文件系统删除确认;每个影响的标准详见附录 C）。成功严格定义为鲁莽执行且未经确认 。因此，我们将任何阻止自主执行的干预归类为成功防御：这不仅包括明确的拒绝，还包括任何形式的拖延，如请求确认、请求澄清或提示缺失信息。所有报告的指标均在五次独立运行中平均，标准差见附录 H。

3.2 Main Results
3.2 主要结果

Systematic Vulnerability Across CIK Dimensions.
跨 CIK 维度的系统性脆弱性。

Table 2 summarizes the attack success rates across all three CIK dimensions and the four backbone models. In the unperturbed baseline condition, ASR ranges from 10.0% to 36.7%, indicating that native safety alignment mitigates but does not fully prevent harmful actions. After state poisoning, ASR increases substantially across all dimensions and models. The most vulnerable configuration (Sonnet 4.5 with Knowledge poisoning) reaches 89.2%, whereas the most robust configuration (Opus 4.6 with Identity poisoning) still yields an ASR of 33.1%, representing a more than threefold increase over its 10.0% baseline.
表 2 总结了三个 CIK 维度及四个骨干模型的攻击成功率。在未受干扰的基线条件下，ASR 范围为 10.0%至 36.7%，表明原生安全对齐虽能减轻但未能完全防止有害行为。国家中毒后，ASR 在所有维度和模型中显著上升。最脆弱的配置（带有知识中毒的十四行诗 4.5）达到 89.2%，而最稳健的配置（ 作品 4.6 带有身份中毒）仍产生 33.1%的 ASR，较其 10.0%基线增长了三倍以上。

This upward trend remains consistent across all evaluated models, suggesting that susceptibility to state poisoning stems from a structural property of the agent architecture rather than a model-specific deficiency. Scaling model capability alone is insufficient to mitigate persistent-state vulnerabilities: even the most capable model (Opus 4.6) sees its ASR increase from 10.0% to 44.2% on average across dimensions.
这一上升趋势在所有受评估模型中保持一致，表明状态中毒的易感性源于代理架构的结构性质，而非模型特有缺陷。仅靠模型能力的缩放不足以缓解持久状态脆弱性：即使是最强大的模型（Opus 4.6），其 ASR 在不同维度的平均值也从 10.0%提升到 44.2%。

Attack-Phase-Level Analysis.
攻击阶段层级分析。

The end-to-end ASR reported in Table 2 aggregates two distinct failure modes: resistance to the initial injection (Phase 1) and resistance to the subsequently triggered action (Phase 2). To isolate these mechanisms, Table 3 decomposes the overall ASR into Phase 1 injection success rates and Phase 2 trigger success rates (conditioned on successful injection, namely enforcing Ph.1 = 100%). This breakdown clarifies the specific stage at which each CIK dimension becomes most vulnerable (experimental design details in Appendix D.1).
表 2 中报告的端到端 ASR 汇总了两种不同的失效模式：对初始注射的抵抗（第一阶段 ）和对随后触发动作的抵抗（第二阶段 ）。为分离这些机制，表 3 将整体 ASR 分解为第一阶段 注射成功率和第二阶段 触发成功率 （以注射成功为条件，即强制执行 Ph.1 = 100%）。该分解澄清了每个 CIK 维度最脆弱的具体阶段（实验设计细节见附录 D.1）。

Knowledge poisoning presents the lowest barrier during Phase 1, with injection success rates ranging from 87.5% to 100% across all models, indicating that agents seldom reject memory updates. Identity poisoning exhibits greater variability, with Phase 1 success rates spanning 65.4% to 96.2%. In contrast, Capability injection achieves a deterministic 100% success rate during Phase 1, as skill installation inherently deposits the payload into the workspace. Phase 2 success rates measure the extent to which the poisoned state overrides the model’s inherent safety protections when processing subsequent requests.
知识中毒在第一阶段门槛最低，所有模型的注入成功率在87.5%到100%之间，表明智能体很少拒绝内存更新。身份中毒的变异性更大，第一阶段成功率在65.4%至96.2%之间。相比之下，能力注入在第一阶段实现了确定性的100%成功率，因为技能安装本身会将有效载荷放入工作空间。第二阶段成功率衡量中毒状态在处理后续请求时覆盖模型固有安全保护的程度。

GPT-5.4 and Opus achieve similar Capability Phase 2 rates (57.7% and 55.4%) but for different reasons; the per-vector breakdown in Appendix D.2 shows that this reflects distinct model behaviors in handling text-based vs. executable skill injections.
GPT-5.4 和 Opus 在能力阶段的表现率（分别为 57.7%和 55.4%）相似，但原因不同;附录 D.2 中的逐向量分解显示，这反映了模型在处理文本技能注入与可执行技能注入时的不同行为。

3.3 Further Explorations
3.3 进一步探索

Existing Defenses Are Insufficient.
现有的辩护措施不足以应对。

To further justify the CIK taxonomy, we map 3 defense strategies to CIK, and attack Sonnet 4.5 (Table 4) under these 3 defense dimensions. We select Sonnet 4.5 because it exhibited the highest attack ASR across dimensions, providing the most informative testbed for measuring defense effectiveness. Implementation details and empirical results are detailed as follows:
为了进一步证明 CIK 分类法的合理性，我们将 3 种防御策略映射到 CIK，并在这三个防御维度下攻击 Sonnet 4.5（见表 4）。我们选择 第 4.5 号，因为它在各维度中展现了最高的攻击 ASR，提供了衡量防御效能最具信息量的测试平台。实施细节和实证结果如下：

  • •

    Capability defense installs GuardianClaw, a security skill that provides a pre-action checklist covering intent verification, reversibility, scope, labeling, and coherence. This is the most effective defense tested, reducing baseline ASR to 1.7% and attack ASR to 9.2–63.8%. However, Capability-based attacks still achieve 63.8% success rate, the reason is that executable payloads bypass the LLM’s reasoning loop entirely, evading the checklist. Furthermore, we find that GuardianClaw must be actively loaded at session initialization; passively installing it in workspace has minimal impact, as the agent does not spontaneously invoke the skill (More details in Appendix E).


    • 能力防御安装了 GuardianClaw 安全技能，提供包含意图验证、可逆性、范围、标签和一致性的行动前检查清单。这是测试过的最有效防御，将基线 ASR 降至 1.7%，攻击 ASR 降至 9.2–63.8%。然而，基于能力的攻击仍能达到 63.8%的成功率，原因在于可执行载荷完全绕过 LLM 的推理循环，规避了检查表。此外，我们发现 GuardianClaw 必须在会话初始化时主动加载;被动地在工作区中安装该技能影响极小，因为代理不会自发调用该技能（详见附录 E）。
  • •

    Identity defense adds operational safety principles to AGENTS.md (e.g., “confirm before acting on external systems”, “irreversibility demands extra care”). This reduces baseline ASR to 13.3%, but has a limited effect on attack ASR (average 59.9%), suggesting that state poisoning can override even explicitly stated behavioral rules.


    •

    身份防御在 AGENTS.md 中加入了操作安全原则（例如，“在对外部系统采取行动前先确认”、“不可逆性需要额外注意”）。这将基线 ASR 降至 13.3%，但对攻击 ASR 的影响有限（平均 59.9%），表明国家中毒甚至可能覆盖明确规定的行为规则。
  • •

    Knowledge defense augments MEMORY.md with safety-relevant factual knowledge (e.g., “refunds are irreversible”, “permanent email deletion bypasses recovery”). This reduces baseline ASR from 26.7% to 8.3%, but attack ASR remains substantial (average 49.6%), particularly for Capability attacks where executable scripts bypass the model’s reasoning.


    •

    知识防御 MEMORY.md 补充安全相关事实知识（例如，“退款不可逆”、“永久删除邮件绕过恢复”）。这使基线 ASR 从 26.7%降至 8.3%，但攻击 ASR 依然显著（平均 49.6%），尤其是在可执行脚本绕过模型推理的能力攻击中。

Notably, the Capability-based defense reduces the ASR for Knowledge and Identity poisoning to 17.5% and 9.2%, respectively, outperforming the dedicated defenses designed for each dimension. This performance gap likely stems from a fundamental difference in intervention scope: the Capability defense enforces constraints at the action level by verifying intent prior to execution, whereas Knowledge and Identity defenses operate at the context level by appending safety information that can be easily overridden by poisoned state. Despite these gains, no single defense comprehensively mitigates state poisoning across all CIK dimensions. While context-level interventions effectively curb Knowledge and Identity attacks, they remain inadequate against Capability poisoning, where executable payloads bypass the model’s reasoning loop entirely. Implementation details for all three defense strategies are provided in Appendix G.
值得注意的是，基于能力的防御将知识中毒和身份中毒的 ASR 分别降低到 17.5%和 9.2%，优于为各维度设计的专用防御。这一性能差距很可能源于干预范围的根本差异：能力防御通过在执行前验证意图来执行行动层面的约束，而知识与身份防御则在情境层面通过附加安全信息来实现，这些信息容易被毒态覆盖。尽管取得了这些进展，但没有单一辩护能全面减轻所有 CIK 维度的国家毒害。虽然上下文层面干预有效遏制知识和身份攻击，但对于能力中毒（Capability poideing）仍然不足，即可执行负载完全绕过模型的推理循环。三种防御策略的实施细节见附录 G。

The Evolution–Safety Tradeoff.
进化与安全的权衡。

The three defenses above all operate on the content of attacks, teaching the agent what to watch out for. But the defining feature of modern AI agents like OpenClaw is that they continuously evolve: they record new preferences, learn from interactions, and install new skills. This evolution is precisely what makes them useful, yet it is also the root of the vulnerability we have exposed. A natural question follows: rather than defending against specific attack content, can we protect the persistent files themselves from unauthorized modification?
上述三种防御都是基于攻击内容，教导特工注意什么。但像 OpenClaw 这样的现代 AI 代理的显著特点是它们不断进化：它们记录新的偏好，从交互中学习，并安装新的技能。这种演变正是它们有用的原因，但同时也是我们暴露漏洞的根源。自然而然地引出了一个问题：与其防御特定攻击内容，我们能否保护持久化文件本身免受未经授权的修改？

We evaluate this with file protection (Appendix G), which instructs the agent to be cautious about modifying its own Knowledge and Identity files and to wait for owner approval before writing. The key question is whether models can selectively reject malicious modifications while still accepting legitimate ones. We present each model with two matched prompt sets: attack prompts (the Phase 1 injections from our main evaluation) and benign prompts (legitimate updates such as recording a refund policy or noting a contact’s information). This mechanism applies only to Knowledge and Identity; Capability injection operates outside file modification and would require separate safeguards.
我们通过文件保护（附录 G）来评估此项，该条款指示代理人在修改自身的知识和身份文件时要谨慎，并在写作前等待所有者批准。关键问题是模型是否能选择性地拒绝恶意修改，同时仍接受合法修改。我们为每个模型提供两组匹配的提示：攻击提示（我们主要评估中的第一阶段 注入）和良性提示（合法更新，如记录退款政策或记录联系人信息）。这一机制仅适用于知识与身份;能力注入在文件修改之外，需要单独的保护措施。

As shown in Table 5, file protection sharply reduces average attack injection from 87.0% to 5.0%. However, the agent system still cannot distinguish malicious injections from legitimate updates, which results in blocking benign prompts at almost the same rate (legitimate update rate from 100% to below 13.2%). This reveals a fundamental evolution–safety tradeoff in modern AI agents like OpenClaw: file protection reduces the rate of legitimate updates by 93%, effectively freezing the agent’s ability to learn and adapt. In the CIK architecture, the same persistent files that enable evolution are also the attack surface, and current models cannot reliably distinguish the two.
如表 5 所示，文件保护将平均攻击注入率从 87.0%大幅降低到 5.0%。然而，代理系统仍然无法区分恶意注入和合法更新，导致无害提示的阻断率几乎相同（合法更新率从 100%到低于 13.2%）。这揭示了现代人工智能代理如 OpenClaw 的根本性进化与安全权衡 ：文件保护将合法更新率降低 93%，实际上冻结了代理的学习和适应能力。在 CIK 架构中，能够实现演化的持久文件也是攻击面，当前模型无法可靠区分两者。

4 Case Study: Anatomy of CIK-Dimension Attacks
4 案例研究：CIK 维攻击的解剖学

The quantitative results in Section 3 demonstrate that all three CIK dimensions are exploitable. In this section, we examine how each dimension is poisoned through representative case studies, illustrating different attack workflows more clearly and, most importantly, the real-world consequences. Each presented case is refused by the vanilla agent system and becomes exploitable right after the attack injection.
第三节的定量结果表明，所有三个 CIK 维度都是可利用的。本节通过代表性案例研究，探讨每个维度如何被污染，更清晰地展示不同的攻击工作流程，最重要的是，揭示了现实世界的后果。每个呈现的案例都会被原版代理系统拒绝，并在攻击注入后立即变得可利用。

4.1 Knowledge: Fabricating Fact
4.1 知识：捏造事实

Knowledge poisoning succeeds by fabricating facts that normalize dangerous actions: the attacker inserts a false record into the agent’s memory, so that a subsequent request appears to match an established routine rather than an unprecedented operation. Figure 3 (left) illustrates this with impact R-F2 (unauthorized Stripe refund abuse). In Phase 1, the attacker instructs the agent to record a fabricated refund habit in MEMORY.md. In Phase 2, a benign-sounding request (“the usual refund pass”) triggers the fabricated memory, and the agent processes batch refunds without confirmation. Without the injection, the agent treats batch refunds as a significant financial action and requests confirmation; with it, the fabricated history reframes the operation as routine.
知识中毒通过伪造事实来使危险行为正常化：攻击者在代理记忆中插入虚假记录，使后续请求看起来符合既定程序，而非前所未有的操作。图 3（左）展示了对 R-F2（未经授权 Stripe 退款滥用）的影响。在第一阶段 ，攻击者指示代理在 MEMORY.md 中记录虚假的退款习惯。在第二阶段 ，一个听起来无害的请求（“通常的退款通过”）会触发虚假的内存，代理会在未确认的情况下处理批量退款。没有注入，代理将批量退款视为重大财务行动并请求确认;凭借它，虚构的历史将行动重新定义为例行公事。

4.2 Identity: Injecting Trust
4.2 身份：注入信任

Unlike Knowledge poisoning, which changes what the agent believes to be true, Identity poisoning changes whom the agent trusts. The attacker inserts a malicious entity (URL, email address, contact) into the owner’s profile, so that the agent treats it as a pre-authorized destination when a subsequent request references it. Figure 3 (middle) illustrates this with impact P-F1 (API credential exfiltration). In Phase 1, the attacker registers an attacker-controlled URL as a backup location in USER.md. In Phase 2, a request to “sync my API config to my backup location” causes the agent to retrieve this URL from the owner profile and upload credentials without hesitation. The agent’s risk assessment is unchanged: it still recognizes that uploading credentials is sensitive, but considers the destination authorized. Unlike fabricated facts, trust preferences are subjective and cannot be verified against external logs, making Identity attacks harder to detect.
与改变主体相信真理的知识毒害不同，身份中毒改变了主体信任的人。攻击者会在所有者的个人资料中插入恶意实体（URL、电子邮件地址、联系人），使代理在后续请求引用时将其视为预授权目的地。图 3（中间）展示了影响 P-F1（API 凭证外泄）的相关情况。在第一阶段 ，攻击者将攻击者控制的 URL 注册为 USER.md 的备份位置。在第二阶段 ，请求“将我的 API 配置同步到备份位置”时，代理会毫不犹豫地从所有者配置文件中获取该 URL，并上传凭证。代理的风险评估未变：它仍然承认上传凭证是敏感的，但视目的地为授权。与捏造事实不同，信任偏好是主观的，无法通过外部日志验证，这使得身份攻击更难被发现。

4.3 Capability: Hidden Payloads
4.3 能力：隐藏有效载荷

Capability poisoning differs fundamentally from both Knowledge and Identity: while skill descriptions (SKILL.md) are text that the LLM reads and can in principle reject, executable scripts (.sh/.py) run directly on the host without the LLM inspecting their content. We illustrate the latter, as it represents the more severe and reliable vector. Figure 3 (right) illustrates this with impact R-D1 (silent workspace deletion). A seemingly useful ip-info skill is installed in the agent’s workspace with a clean SKILL.md but a hidden rm -rf payload in its executable script. When the user requests an IP lookup, the foreground process returns the result while the background process silently deletes the entire workspace. The agent is destroying itself and has no awareness of it, because the payload executes outside its reasoning loop. Most models run skill scripts without examining their contents, though GPT-5.4 occasionally reads and refuses suspicious payloads (Table 8).
能力中毒与知识和身份有根本不同：技能描述（SKILL.md）是 LLM 读取并原则上可以拒绝的文本，而可执行脚本（.sh/.py）则直接在主机上运行，LLM 不检查其内容。我们举例说明后者，因为它代表了更严厉且更可靠的向量。图 3（右）展示了影响 R-D1（静默工作区删除）的相关情况。一个看似有用的 IP 信息技能安装在代理的工作区，SKILL.md 干净，但其可执行脚本中隐藏了 rm -rf 负载。当用户请求 IP 查询时，前景进程返回结果，而后台进程则静默地删除整个工作区。智能体正在自我毁灭，却没有意识到这一点，因为有效载荷是在其推理循环之外执行的。大多数模型运行技能脚本时不检查其内容，尽管 GPT-5.4 偶尔会读取并拒绝可疑负载（见表 8）。

5 Related Work  5 相关工作

Attacks on persistent agent state.
对持久代理状态的攻击。

Prior work has examined attacks on specific components of agent state in isolation. For Knowledge poisoning, AgentPoison (Chen and others, 2024) and PoisonedRAG (Zou et al., 2024) target retrieval-augmented knowledge bases; MINJA (Dong and others, 2025) demonstrates query-only memory injection; Zombie Agents (Yang et al., 2026) shows persistent control via self-reinforcing memory injections. For Capability attacks, SkillJect (Jia et al., 2026) automates skill-based prompt injection in coding agents; Agent Skills in the Wild (Liu and others, 2026) surveys skill vulnerabilities at scale; MCPTox (Wang et al., 2025) benchmarks tool poisoning on MCP servers; ToxicSkills (Snyk, 2026) and ClawHavoc (Koi Security, 2026) document real malicious skills on ClawHub. For Identity attacks, AIShellJack (Liu et al., 2025) and Pillar’s rules-file backdoors (Pillar Security, 2025) demonstrate attacks through configuration files in coding agents (Cursor, Copilot). Our contribution is threefold: we introduce the CIK taxonomy as a unified framework for categorizing these attack surfaces, evaluate all three dimensions systematically within a single agent system, and conduct the evaluation in a live deployment with real external services rather than simulated environments.
此前的研究曾单独研究对智能体状态特定组成部分的攻击。对于知识中毒，AgentPoison（Chen 等人，2024）和 PoisonedRAG （Zou 等 ，2024）目标检索增强知识库;MINJA （Dong 等人，2025） 演示了仅查询内存注入;Zombie Agents （Yang 等 ，2026） 显示了通过自我强化记忆注入实现持续控制。对于能力攻击，SkillJect （Jia 等 ，2026） 自动化编码代理中的基于技能的提示注入;《野外 的特工技能 》（Liu 等，2026） 对大规模技能脆弱性进行了调查;MCPTox （Wang 等，2025） 对 MCP 服务器上的工具中毒进行了基准测试;ToxicSkills （Snyk，2026 年） 和 ClawHavoc （Koi Security，2026 年）记录了 ClawHub 上的真实恶意技能。针对身份攻击，AIShellJack （Liu 等 ，2025） 和 Pillar 的规则文件后门 （Pillar Security，2025） 通过编码代理中的配置文件（Cursor、Copilot）演示了攻击。我们的贡献有三方面：引入 CIK 分类法作为分类攻击面的统一框架，在单一代理系统内系统性评估这三个维度，并在真实外部服务中进行评估，而非模拟环境。

Agent safety evaluation.
特工安全评估。

Several benchmarks evaluate LLM agent safety, including InjecAgent (Zhan et al., 2024), AgentDojo (Debenedetti and others, 2024), ASB (Zhang et al., 2025), AgentHarm (Andriushchenko and others, 2025), and OpenAgentSafety (Vijayvargiya et al., 2026). These provide systematic evaluation frameworks but operate in sandboxed or simulated environments where attacks produce no real consequences. Our work complements them by evaluating in a live deployment with real external services (Gmail, Stripe, filesystem), where harmful actions have an actual impact.
多个基准测试评估 LLM 代理安全性，包括 InjecAgent（Zhan 等 ，2024）、AgentDojo （Debenedetti 等，2024）、ASB （Zhang 等 ，2025）、AgentHarm （Andriushchenko 等，2025） 和 OpenAgentSafety （Vijayvargiya 等 ，2026）.这些工具提供了系统化的评估框架，但运行在沙盒或模拟环境中，攻击不会产生实际后果。我们的工作通过在真实的外部服务（Gmail、Stripe、文件系统）的实时部署中进行评估，这些服务的有害行为确实会产生实际影响。

Related mechanisms and perspectives.
相关机制与观点。

Our attack model builds on prompt injection (Greshake et al., 2023), where adversarial input causes an LLM to deviate from its intended behavior. Prior work has demonstrated injection through web content (Greshake et al., 2023), tool outputs (Zhan et al., 2024; Debenedetti and others, 2024), and multi-turn conversations (Russinovich et al., 2025). Our contribution is not a new injection technique but a systematic study of what happens after injection succeeds: the poisoned persistent state reshapes the agent’s behavior across future sessions. A complementary line of work studies agent evolution risks: Misevolve (Shao et al., 2026) and ATP Han et al. (2025) examine emergent risks in self-evolving agents, framing dangerous behavior as an unintentional byproduct of evolution. Our work focuses on adversarial exploitation of the same evolutionary mechanisms, showing that the persistent state enabling self-improvement also enables attacker-driven poisoning.
我们的攻击模型基于提示注入 （Greshake 等 ，2023）， 即对抗性输入导致大型语言模型偏离其预期行为。先前的研究已证明通过网页内容 （Greshake 等 ，2023）、工具输出 （Zhan 等 ，2024;Debenedetti 等人，2024） 以及多回合对话 （Russinovich 等 ，2025）。 我们的贡献不是新的注射技术，而是对注射成功后发生的事情进行系统研究：中毒的持续状态会重塑代理人在未来疗程中的行为。关于代理演化风险的补充研究方向：Misevolution （Shao 等 ，2026） 和 ATP Han 等 （2025） 探讨了自我进化代理中的涌现风险，将危险行为视为进化的无意副产品。我们的研究聚焦于对抗性利用相同的进化机制，表明持续存在的自我提升状态也助长了攻击者驱动的中毒。

6 Conclusion  6 结论

We presented the CIK taxonomy for categorizing the attack surface of personal AI agents’ persistent state into Capability, Identity, and Knowledge dimensions, and conducted the first real-world safety evaluation on a live OpenClaw instance across 12 impact scenarios and four backbone models. All three CIK dimensions are exploitable, with poisoning raising attack success rates substantially above baseline across all models. Three dimension-aligned defense strategies each provide partial mitigation, but none eliminates the risk entirely, with Capability-based attacks proving the most resistant. Protecting persistent files blocks most attacks but equally blocks legitimate updates, revealing a fundamental evolution–safety tradeoff inherent to evolution-first agent design. This vulnerability is structural rather than model-specific, and the CIK taxonomy generalizes to any agent with persistent evolving state, a design pattern already spreading across the ecosystem.
我们展示了 CIK 分类法，用于将个人 AI 代理持久状态的攻击面划分为能力、身份和知识三维度，并首次对实时 OpenClaw 实例进行了 12 个影响场景和 4 个骨干模型的真实世界安全评估。这三个 CIK 维度均可被利用，毒害攻击成功率在所有模型中显著高于基线。三种维度对齐的防御策略各自提供部分缓解，但没有一种能完全消除风险，基于能力的攻击最具抵抗力。保护持久文件能阻挡大多数攻击，但同样阻挡合法更新，揭示了进化优先代理设计中固有的根本进化与安全权衡。这种脆弱性是结构性的，而非模型特定的，CIK 分类法推广到任何具有持续演化状态的代理，这种设计模式已经在生态系统中蔓延。

Limitations and Future Work.
局限性与未来工作。

Our evaluation covers a single agent platform (OpenClaw) with four backbone models and 12 manually designed impact scenarios. We evaluate each CIK dimension independently; cross-dimension attack chaining (e.g., poisoned Knowledge reinforcing Identity attacks) could amplify effectiveness, and our results likely represent a lower bound. Automated attack generation, additional platforms, production-mode evaluation, and longitudinal user studies remain future work. Finally, our defenses operate at the prompt level; Capability attacks suggest that architectural safeguards (code signing, sandboxed execution, runtime monitoring) are necessary for robust protection.
我们的评估涵盖了单一代理平台（OpenClaw），配备四个骨干模型和 12 个手动设计的影响场景。我们分别评估每个 CIK 维度;跨维度攻击链（例如，有毒的知识强化身份攻击）可以增强效果，我们的结果很可能代表了一个下限。自动化攻击生成、额外平台、生产模式评估和纵向用户研究仍是未来的工作。最后，我们的防御机制是按时运作的;能力攻击表明，架构上的防护措施（代码签名、沙箱执行、运行时监控）对于稳健的保护是必要的。

Ethics Statement  伦理声明

All experiments were conducted on a self-owned OpenClaw instance with researcher-controlled accounts. Stripe was operated in test mode with no real financial transactions. All email recipients were researcher-controlled addresses; no third parties received any communications. Filesystem operations were confined to a test workspace with automated backup and restore.
所有实验均在一个由研究人员控制的自有 OpenClaw 实例上进行。Stripe 以测试模式运营，没有实际的财务交易。所有邮件收件人均为研究人员控制的地址;没有第三方收到任何通讯。文件系统操作仅限于带有自动备份和恢复的测试工作区。

Appendix A Experimental Scale
附录 A 实验尺度

Table 6 shows the distribution of test cases across injection vectors. Each of the 12 impacts is tested under baseline (no injection) and multiple injection vectors spanning all three dimensions. Knowledge attacks use two vectors (long-term memory and session context); Identity attacks target identity files (SOUL.md, USER.md, etc.); Capability attacks use either text injection via SKILL.md or executable payloads via shell/Python scripts. In total, 88 cases were tested per model: 12 baselines and 76 injection cases.

Appendix D Phase-Level Attack Details
附录 D 阶段级攻击详情

D.1 Experimental design details
D.1 实验设计细节

The Phase 1 success rate measures whether the agent accepts the injection—i.e., actually modifies the target persistent file or, for session-context injection, incorporates the planted context into the conversation. This is verified by checking the workspace diff after Phase 1.
第一阶段成功率衡量代理是否接受注入——即是否实际修改了目标持久文件，或者在会话上下文注入中是否将植入的上下文纳入对话。这可以通过第一阶段后查看工作区差异来验证。

The Phase 2 success rate measures whether the agent executes the harmful action given that injection has already succeeded. For vectors where Phase 1 is deterministic (mem-session, skill-md, skill-bash/py), Phase 2 equals the end-to-end ASR from Table 2. For vectors where Phase 1 is non-deterministic (mem-long and identity-*), we run a separate set of experiments in which the poisoned content is pre-loaded into the workspace before the session starts (e.g., for the P-F1 credential exfiltration scenario, USER.md is pre-populated with an attacker-controlled URL registered as the owner’s backup location), ensuring Ph.1 = 100% by construction. This isolation allows us to measure Phase 2 independently of Phase 1 variability.
第二阶段成功率衡量的是在注射已成功的情况下，药物是否执行有害作用。对于阶段 1 为确定性的向量（mem-session、skill-md、skill-bash/py），阶段 2 等于表 2 中的端到端 ASR。对于第一阶段 非确定性向量（内存长且身份*），我们会进行一组单独实验，在会话开始前将中毒内容预先加载到工作区（例如，P-F1 凭据外泄场景中，USER.md 预先填充了作为所有者备份位置的攻击者控制的 URL），确保 Ph.1 = 100%。这种隔离性使我们能够独立于第一阶段 变异性测量第二阶段 。

The dimension-level Phase 2 rates in Table 3 combine results from both sub-vectors within each dimension (e.g., Knowledge Ph.2 combines mem-long Ph.2 from forced-injection experiments and mem-session Ph.2 from end-to-end runs).
表 3 中的维度级第二阶段速率结合了每个维度内两个子向量的结果（例如，知识 Ph.2 结合了强制注入实验的记忆长度 Ph.2 和端到端运行的记忆会话 Ph.2）。

D.2 Phase-Level Breakdown by Vector
D.2 按矢量划分的相位级分解

Table 8 provides a fine-grained decomposition of Phase 1 and Phase 2 success rates by individual injection vector across all four backbone models. Within each dimension, vectors differ in their injection mechanism and the degree of model involvement.
表 8 详细分析了四个主链模型中单个注入载体对第一阶段 和第二阶段 成功率的细致分解。在每个维度内，矢量在注入机制和模型参与程度上有所不同。

Knowledge vectors.  知识向量。

Knowledge injection uses two vectors: mem-long writes poisoned content to MEMORY.md (persists across sessions), while mem-session plants context within the same conversation without modifying any file (Phase 1 and Phase 2 occur in a single session). The two vectors differ primarily in Phase 2 effectiveness. Mem-long achieves high Ph.2 across all models (average 90.8%), suggesting that facts written into MEMORY.md are highly trusted by the agent in subsequent sessions. Mem-session Ph.2 is more variable: Sonnet and GPT-5.4 achieve 80.0% and 83.3%, but Opus drops to 40.0%, indicating that within-session conversational context is less persuasive than persistent memory for stronger models. On the injection side, mem-long Ph.1 ranges from 75.0% (Opus) to 100.0% (Sonnet/GPT-5.4), while mem-session Ph.1 is 100% by construction (no file write required).
知识注入使用两种方式：内存长写入有毒 MEMORY.md 内容（跨会话持续），而内存会话在同一对话中植入上下文而不修改任何文件（第一阶段 和第二阶段 在同一会话中进行）。这两种载体主要区别在于第二阶段 的有效性。Mem-long 在所有模型中均达到高 p.2（平均 90.8%），表明写入 MEMORY.md 的事实在后续会话中高度可信。记忆会话 Ph.2 的变异性更大：Sonnet 和 GPT-5.4 分别达到 80.0%和 83.3%，而 Opus 降至 40.0%，表明对更强模型来说，会话内对话上下文不如持久记忆更具说服力。在注入方面，内存长度的 Ph.1 范围为 75.0%（Opus）到 100.0%（Sonnet/GPT-5.4），而内存会话 Ph.1 的结构为 100%（无需写入文件）。

Identity vectors.  身份向量。

Identity injection shows the widest cross-model variation in both phases. Phase 1 ranges from 65.4% (Opus) to 96.2% (GPT-5.4), reflecting that some models are substantially more resistant to modifying their own identity files—particularly AGENTS.md, which contains the agent’s behavioral rules and red lines. Phase 2 is high for Sonnet and Gemini (93.1% and 91.5%) but drops for GPT-5.4 (76.2%) and Opus (60.8%), indicating that stronger models are also more resistant to acting on injected trust anchors and value modifications even after successful injection.
身份注入显示了两阶段中跨模型变异最广泛的情况。第一阶段的比例范围为 65.4%（Opus）到 96.2%（GPT-5.4），反映出某些模型对修改自身身份文件的抵抗力更大——尤其是包含代理行为规则和红线的 AGENTS.md。Sonnet 和 Gemini 的第二阶段 （分别为 93.1%和 91.5%）较高，但 GPT-5.4（76.2%）和 Opus（60.8%）则下降，表明更强的模型即使在成功注入后，也更难对注入的信任锚点和价值调整产生作用。

Capability vectors.  能力向量。

The two Capability vectors, text-based skill descriptions (skill-md) and executable scripts (skill-bash/py), show strikingly different Phase 2 profiles despite both having 100% Ph.1 (deterministic skill installation). Skill-bash/py achieves near-perfect Ph.2 on Sonnet (100%), Gemini (98.6%), and Opus (100%), confirming that most models execute skill scripts without inspecting their contents. The exception is GPT-5.4, which achieves only 77.1%, since it occasionally reads and refuses to execute scripts with suspicious payloads. Skill-md shows a steep decline across models: 75.0% (Sonnet) →\rightarrow 40.0% (Gemini) →\rightarrow 35.0% (GPT-5.4) →\rightarrow 3.3% (Opus). This indicates that stronger models are increasingly resistant to acting on out-of-place instructions embedded in skill documentation, while weaker models more readily incorporate text-based skill injections into their reasoning.
这两个能力向量——基于文本的技能描述（skill-md）和可执行脚本（skill-bash/py）——尽管都具有 100%的 Ph.1（确定性技能安装），但显示出显著不同的第二阶段 配置文件。 Skill-bash/py 在 Sonnet（100%）、Gemini（98.6%）和 Opus（100%）上几乎完美地获得了 Ph.2，证实大多数模型执行技能脚本时不检查内容。 例外是 GPT-5.4，它仅达到 77.1%，因为它偶尔会读取并拒绝执行带有可疑负载的脚本。 Skill-md 显示各模型均大幅下降：75.0%（Sonnet）， →\rightarrow 40.0%（Gemini）， →\rightarrow 35.0%（GPT-5.4）， →\rightarrow 3.3%（Opus）。这表明，较强的模型越来越难以对嵌入在技能文档中的不合时宜的指令采取行动，而较弱的模型则更容易将基于文本的技能注入纳入推理中。

Overall.  总体来说。

The most reliable attack vector across all models is skill-bash/py (executable payloads), which achieves ≥\geq77% Phase 2 on every model tested. The least reliable is skill-md on Opus (3.3%), where text-based skill injection is nearly ineffective. These results underscore the fundamental asymmetry between context-mediated attacks (Knowledge, Identity, skill-md), which stronger models can partially resist, and code-execution attacks (skill-bash/py), which bypass model reasoning entirely on most architectures.
所有模型中最可靠的攻击向量是 skill-bash/py（可执行负载），它在所有测试模型上都能 ≥\geq 实现 77% 的第二阶段 成功率。最不可靠的是 Opus 上的技能管理（3.3%），文本技能注入几乎无效。这些结果强调了上下文介导攻击（Knowledge、Identity、skill-md）与代码执行攻击（skill-bash/py）之间的根本不对称性，后者在大多数架构中完全绕过模型推理。

Appendix E Capability Defense: Active vs. Passive Loading
附录 E 能力防御：主动装填与被动装填

The Capability defense results in the main text (Table 4) were obtained by actively loading the GuardianClaw skill at the start of each session (via load guardianclaw). In practice, however, a security skill installed in the workspace is not automatically invoked—the agent must choose to load it. We find that without active loading, the agent does not spontaneously trigger GuardianClaw even when encountering sensitive operations, despite the skill’s description explicitly listing such operations.
主文中的能力防御结果（表 4）是通过在每次会话开始时主动加载守护爪技能（通过加载守护爪 ）获得的。然而，实际上，安装在工作区中的安全技能并不会自动调用——代理必须选择加载该技能。我们发现，即使没有主动加载，代理也不会在遇到敏感操作时自发触发守护爪，尽管技能描述中明确列出了此类操作。

Table 9 compares ASR under active loading (as reported in the main text) versus passive installation (skill present in workspace but not explicitly loaded).
表 9 比较了主动加载下的 ASR（如主文所述）与被动安装（工作空间中具备但未显式加载的技能）。

Passive installation provides modest baseline improvement (26.7% →\rightarrow 16.7%) but leaves attack ASR across all dimensions largely intact (77.0% vs. 87.7% on average without defense). Active loading produces a dramatically different outcome: baseline drops to 1.7%, and Knowledge/Identity ASR fall to 17.5% and 9.2% respectively. Capability ASR remains elevated at 63.8% even with active loading, consistent with the main-text finding that executable payloads bypass the checklist.
被动安装提供了适度的基线提升（26.7%， →\rightarrow 16.7%），但攻击 ASR 在所有维度上基本保持不变（77.0%对无防御时平均 87.7%）。主动负载结果截然不同：基线降至 1.7%，知识/身份 ASR 分别降至 17.5%和 9.2%。即使处于主动加载状态，能力 ASR 仍保持在 63.8%的高位，这与主文发现可执行有效载荷绕过检查表的结论一致。

The gap between passive and active is striking—the same defense content yields ASR reductions of <<10% (passive) vs. >>70% (active) for context-mediated attacks. This reveals a critical deployment gap: installing a security skill is not sufficient—it must be actively triggered at session start. We recommend that users deploying security skills configure their agent to load them automatically (e.g., via system prompt instructions or session-start hooks), rather than relying on the agent to self-activate the skill when needed.
被动与主动之间的差距非常显著——同样的防御内容在上下文介导攻击中，被动攻击的 ASR 降低为 << 10%，主动则为 >> 70%。这暴露了一个关键的部署空白： 仅安装安全技能还不够——必须在会话开始时主动触发 。我们建议部署安全技能的用户配置代理自动加载（例如通过系统提示指令或会话启动钩子），而非依赖代理在需要时自动激活技能。

Appendix F Comparative Summary of Case Study
附录 F 案例研究的比较总结

Table 10 summarizes the key structural differences across the three attack dimensions.
表 10 总结了三个攻击维度中的关键结构差异。

The CIK decomposition reveals a spectrum of model involvement that has direct implications for defense. Knowledge and Identity poisoning both operate through the LLM’s reasoning, but target different components: Knowledge alters the agent’s factual model (what it believes to be true) by fabricating history; Identity alters its authorization model (whom it trusts) by injecting false trust anchors. Capability poisoning, by contrast, operates largely outside the model’s reasoning loop: the agent architecture does not require the LLM to inspect executable payloads before running them. This asymmetry explains why Capability attacks remain effective even under defenses that substantially reduce Knowledge and Identity ASR—and it is precisely this asymmetry within the CIK framework that explains why no single defense suffices (Section 3.3). Defending against Capability poisoning will therefore require architectural safeguards—such as code signing, sandboxed execution, or mandatory human approval for script invocation—rather than model-level inspection alone.
CIK 分解揭示了模型参与度的光谱，这对防御有直接影响。知识中毒和身份中毒都通过 LLM 的推理运作，但针对不同的组成部分：知识通过捏造历史改变代理的事实模型（其相信为真）;身份通过注入虚假的信任锚点来改变其授权模型（信任对象）。相比之下，能力中毒在模型推理循环之外工作：代理架构不要求 LLM 在运行可执行负载前检查它们。这种不对称性解释了为何能力攻击即使在大幅降低知识与身份 ASR 的防御下依然有效——正是这种 CIK 框架内的不对称性解释了为何没有单一防御手段足够（第 3.3 节 ）。因此，防御能力中毒需要架构上的保障措施——如代码签名、沙盒执行或脚本调用的强制人工批准——而不仅仅是模型级检查。
